entries.title: Mark 16:1
segments: When the Sabbath was over, Mary of Magdala, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought some spices, so that they might go and anoint the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 16:2
segments: And very early on the first day of the week they went to the tomb, after sunrise.

entries.title: Mark 16:3
segments: They were saying to one another: "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance of the tomb?"

entries.title: Mark 16:4
segments: But, on looking up, they saw that the stone had already been rolled back; it was a very large one.

entries.title: Mark 16:5
segments: Going into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on their right, in a white robe, and they were dismayed; But he said to them:

entries.title: Mark 16:6
segments: "Do not be dismayed; you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified; he has risen, he is not here! Look! Here is the place where they laid him.

entries.title: Mark 16:7
segments: But go, and say to his disciples and to Peter 'He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him, as he told you.'"

entries.title: Mark 16:8
segments: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for they were trembling and bewildered; and they did not say a word to any one, for they were frightened;

entries.title: Mark 16:9
segments: After his rising again, early on the first day of the week, Jesus appeared first of all to Mary of Magdala, from whom he had driven out seven demons.

entries.title: Mark 16:10
segments: She went and told the news to those who had been with him and who were now in sorrow and tears;

entries.title: Mark 16:11
segments: Yet even they, when they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, did not believe it.

entries.title: Mark 16:12
segments: Afterwards, altered in appearance, he made himself known to two of them, as they were walking, on their way into the country.

entries.title: Mark 16:13
segments: They also went and told the rest, but they did not believe even them.

entries.title: Mark 16:14
segments: Later on, he made himself known to the Eleven themselves as they were at a meal, and reproached them with their want of faith and their stubbornness, because they did not believe those who had seen him after he had risen from the dead.

entries.title: Mark 16:15
segments: Then he said to them: "Go into all the world, and proclaim the Good News to all creation.

entries.title: Mark 16:16
segments: He who believes and is baptized shall be saved; but he who refuses to believe will be condemned.

entries.title: Mark 16:17
segments: Moreover these signs shall attend those who believe. In my Name they shall drive out demons; they shall speak with 'tongues';

entries.title: Mark 16:18
segments: They shall take up serpents in their hands; and, if they drink any poison, it shall not hurt them; they will place their hands on sick people and they shall recover."

entries.title: Mark 16:19
segments: So the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into Heaven, and sat at the right hand of God.

entries.title: Mark 16:20
segments: But they set out, and made the proclamation everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the Message by the signs which attended it.
